label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Hypomagnesemia replacement trial in medical inpatients does not define EMC tumor scope; general adult admission is not a solid-tumor basket.
cohort_reconciliation: Magnesium supplementation and no-treatment control share magnesium-level entry and critical-illness exclusions.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Magnesium concentration required, not a tumor biomarker or fusion.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; individual cancer comorbidity and critical-condition interpretation are unknown.

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Alzheimer-type dementia agitation study provides no EMC cancer-scope evidence. Pain-related agitation is excluded but does not establish universal cancer exclusion.
cohort_reconciliation: Low/high masupirdine and placebo arms share Alzheimer-type agitation eligibility.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; investigator discretion and symptom attribution remain individual questions.
quotes: Has a diagnosis of dementia of the Alzheimer's type
Has symptoms of agitation that are not secondary to Alzheimer's disease

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Labor induction/augmentation study uses EMC in the study identifier, with no tumor-scope evidence.
cohort_reconciliation: Both oxytocin-dose arms concern term singleton cephalic pregnancies with obesity; no cancer cohort.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; pregnancy and obstetric suitability do not adjudicate EMC cancer comorbidity. NOT_YET_RECRUITING snapshot.
quotes: Women at term (37-42 weeks), requiring the use of oxytocin for induction of labor or for augmentation of labor.

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Type 2 diabetes glucose-monitoring comparison gives no EMC tumor-scope evidence. Generic comorbidity and MRI restrictions cannot establish exclusion for all EMC.
cohort_reconciliation: Intermittent and real-time glucose-monitoring arms both concern insulin-treated T2D and shared usual care.
extra_biomarker_requirement: HbA1c and glucose requirements are not tumor biomarkers.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; MRI need and comorbid disease remain individual unknowns. NOT_YET_RECRUITING snapshot.
quotes: Having a condition that would likely require an MRI during the study period.

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: GERD device trial expressly excludes any other malignancy in the last two years, restricting recent EMC scope; it is not an oncology treatment study.
cohort_reconciliation: Active and sham device arms share eligibility after washout and pH testing, including malignancy exclusions.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Acid-exposure measurement is a GERD gate, not a tumor biomarker.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; two-year restriction is retained and does not establish exclusion for remote cured disease.
quotes: History of any other malignancy in the last 2 years

label: broad_tumor_compatible
rationale: Phase I and non-Ewing expansion cohorts admit refractory/recurrent non-CNS solid tumors; EMC can fit broad scope without pretending it is Ewing sarcoma or has a DNA-repair alteration.
cohort_reconciliation: Phase I A/B dose finding has broad non-CNS solid malignancy scope.
A1/B1 non-Ewing expansions remain broadly compatible. A2 separately requires a deleterious HR-repair/DSB-signaling alteration documented by qualifying sequencing.
Phase II requires Ewing histology with EWSR1-FLI1 or other EWS rearrangement; EMC's EWSR1 status alone is insufficient for this arm.
extra_biomarker_requirement: A2 HR/DSB alteration is required and unestablished; no such alteration assumed. A1/B1 and phase I do not state this molecular gate.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and current phase/cohort opening unverified; descriptions say expansions open after RP2Ds. Strict age >12 months and <30 years differs at boundaries from metadata; no individual eligibility inference. Description enrollment totals differ from structured 90.
quotes: Patients with refractory or recurrent non-central nervous system (CNS) solid tumors not amenable to curative treatment are eligible.
with a deleterious alteration in germline or somatic genes involved in HR repair and DSBs signaling

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: MASH cirrhosis study supplies no EMC cancer-scope evidence; liver disease eligibility does not imply solid-tumor inclusion.
cohort_reconciliation: Survodutide and placebo groups share compensated-MASH-cirrhosis entry; no oncology arm.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Liver fat/fibrosis criteria are not tumor molecular eligibility.
protocol_uncertainty: Further inclusion/exclusion criteria explicitly apply; external protocol and cancer comorbidity restrictions unreviewed.
